description: This PHP class 'ChannelProgramTransformer' is part of the Goteo project, located in the namespace Goteo\-Util\-ModelNormalizer\-Transformer. It extends an abstract transformer to convert a model related to a 'channel program' into a format suitable for further processing or output, providing methods to get description, image, and actions related to a channel program model.

classes.name: ChannelProgramTransformer
classes.description: A class that transforms a channel program model into a specific format, providing methods to retrieve description, image, and action URLs based on user permissions.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the channel program from the model.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns a link to the header image of the channel program if available; otherwise, null.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns an array of URLs for actions like editing or translating the channel program, based on user permissions.
